name: Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery
traveler: Meriwether Lewis, William Clark, Sacagawea and York
summary: A U.S. Army company sent by Jefferson to find a water route to the Pacific and to map the lands bought from France. Guided and helped by many Native nations, among them the Shoshone woman Sacagawea, they reach the Pacific and come back with maps, specimens and the news that no easy route exists.

stops.note: About 45 men start up the Missouri.
First council with Oto and Missouria leaders.
Winter among the Mandan and Hidatsa; Sacagawea and Toussaint Charbonneau join.
A month to haul the boats around the falls.
They cross the Continental Divide; the Shoshone chief turns out to be Sacagawea's brother.
Near starvation crossing the Bitterroot Mountains in snow.
The Nez Perce feed them and keep their horses.
'Ocian in view! O! the joy.' Winter on the Pacific coast.
Back after 28 months, long given up for dead.
